Definition: Enumerated deliverable lifecycle state (OPEN, INITIALIZED, SEMANTIC_READY, IN_PROGRESS, CHECKING, ISSUED) ordered by STATE_INDEX.
A from/to lifecycle state pair with the set of ActorRequirements authorized to perform it.
Authorized actor category for a transition: PREPARATION, 4_DOCUMENTS, CHIRALITY_FRAMEWORK, WORKING_ITEMS, HUMAN.
Git SHA-like hexadecimal token (7-64 chars) required as evidence for human-gate transitions to CHECKING or ISSUED.
A lifecycle transition targeting CHECKING or ISSUED that requires human authorization and approvalSha.
An active UPSTREAM dependency of class EXECUTION and target type DELIVERABLE with a blocking type and unsatisfied status.
A row of a deliverable Dependencies.csv register with fields like DependencyClass, Status, Direction, DependencyType, TargetType, SatisfactionStatus, Notes.
Per-deliverable markdown file holding lifecycle state and history.
Per-deliverable CSV register of dependencies for a deliverable.
Identifier for a resizable layout pane: fileTree, toolkit, or chat.
Persisted layout state of pane widths and collapsed flags keyed by ResizablePaneKey.
A directory matching DEL-NN-NN containing _STATUS.md, representing a deliverable.
A classification of deliverable knowledge files (Datasheet, Specification, etc.); directories match KTY-XX-XX.
Electron preload bridge exposed on Window providing platform info and selectDirectory.
Task scoping mode, either DELIVERABLES or KNOWLEDGE_TYPES.
